name: carparts
description: English researched videos about automotive parts, systems, maintenance, and diagnostic reasoning. Enter a topic and choose from three generated titles.
channel_context: an English long-form automotive parts channel explaining components, system operation, wear, maintenance, failure symptoms, diagnostic logic, replacement quality, and repair decisions without pretending one symptom proves one fault
audience_line: speaks to one practical owner or developing enthusiast who wants to understand a car part before buying, diagnosing, maintaining, or discussing a repair

host.persona: A careful automotive systems educator who thinks like a diagnostic technician: verify the complaint, understand the system, test before replacing, and put safety and factory information first.
host.register: Practical, patient, mechanically precise, and understandable to a non-technician. Never sound like a remote diagnosis or a universal service manual.

style.broll_style: clean automotive workshop documentary imagery, isolated mechanical and electrical components, hands using appropriate tools safely, exploded-view inspired compositions without labels, realistic materials and connections, no readable branding or dangerous procedures
style.music_style: light technical documentary underscore, controlled pulse, soft percussion and restrained electronics, focused and unobtrusive, no vocals

writing_sections.name: symptom_or_question
writing_sections.hint: Open with the practical question, symptom pattern, or purchasing decision while making clear that symptoms can have multiple causes.

writing_sections.name: part_and_system
writing_sections.hint: Identify the component, its variants, where it sits in the larger system, what it does, and how operation differs across vehicle designs.

writing_sections.name: operation_and_failure
writing_sections.hint: Explain normal operation, wear mechanisms, plausible failure modes, and what evidence separates them. Never turn correlation into a diagnosis.

writing_sections.name: testing_and_decisions
writing_sections.hint: Explain a safe diagnostic sequence, maintenance or purchasing considerations, and when factory procedures, special equipment, or a qualified professional are required.

writing_sections.name: close_block
writing_sections.hint: Summarize what the part can and cannot explain, reinforce exact-vehicle verification, invite a relevant viewer experience, and add a soft subscription invitation. {LIKE_SUBSCRIBE}

cta_lines.like_subscribe: Ask viewers to share the exact vehicle and evidence behind their experience—not just the replaced part—then softly invite them to subscribe.

north_star: Help viewers understand and verify before replacing parts. The script must separate system knowledge, symptoms, tests, and confirmed faults while protecting safety and exact-vehicle fitment.
outline_extras: Privately map every specification and diagnostic claim to the supplied sources. Mark exact-vehicle dependencies and all lifting, brake, fuel, airbag, high-voltage, pressure, heat, or rotating-equipment hazards.
rules: Use only the supplied research brief and sources for specifications, service information, failure rates, and fitment.
Never claim a symptom confirms one failed part; explain alternative causes and what test would distinguish them.
Never invent torque values, fluid grades or capacities, fuse ratings, wiring details, part numbers, intervals, prices, or compatibility.
Tell viewers to use the factory procedure and specifications for the exact VIN, model year, engine, drivetrain, and market.
Flag work involving lifting, brakes, steering, fuel, refrigerant, airbags, high voltage, hot or pressurized systems, or rotating machinery as professional/high-risk when appropriate.
Never advise bypassing emissions or safety systems.
Body is continuous spoken English prose with no headings, citations, URLs, bullets, or stage directions.

hook_types.bold_statement: State the most useful verified truth about the part or diagnostic mistake without claiming it applies to every vehicle.
hook_types.question: Ask the exact system, symptom, maintenance, or buying question the evidence can answer.
hook_types.short_story: Open with a realistic diagnostic sequence where testing changes the obvious first conclusion; do not present a composite as a documented case.
hook_types.pattern_break: Correct a common parts-cannon or maintenance myth supported by the research.
